blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed 2026-10-19. Census circulating-supply coverage is unavailable, so all six registered deployments were measured directly instead of treating a missing chain as material by default. Ethereum totalSupply is 39,353,792.921656 at block 26224773 (2026-10-19T06:16:47Z); Base is 709 at block 52800636; Solana is 521 at finalized slot 458730415; Polygon (block 0x5b5a459), Tempo (44841402) and Arc (26729362) return zero. The full additive registered-token-supply denominator is 39,355,022.921656 CHFAU: Ethereum 99.996875%, Base 0.001802%, Solana 0.001324%. At Ethereum block 26224761 (2026-10-19T06:14:23Z), CHFAU resolves to verified AllUnity implementation 0x5cad3aaaef687009665d15fed23ded57862ee003 and uses external blacklist registry 0xeafba0d16d6a0ff3c6c5d0a46ca7b8fbff21a9d3. Registry BLACKLISTER_ROLE is actively held by EOA 0x72b604de032cb733e18d06d91ccc87bb4a9df637. Current _update checks restrict blacklisted transfer senders and recipients, and the implementation supports role-gated burn from blacklisted holders. Thus the material Ethereum deployment establishes Yes. Whitepaper v1.2 Clause 3(4) expressly reserves blacklisted-address transfer blocking. Solana's current freeze, permanent-delegate and pause authority remains APJqyTzEng2jeLoyvRSZYgTpaZDBdxMetkvUSmvRMbTP, confirming the earlier slot 452213349 observation, but it is immaterial and not verdict-setting. No declared parent; the CHF reserve basket is secondary to this direct control.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AllUnity publishes CHFAU as an issuer-native asset on Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Tempo, Solana, and Arc. Ethereum, Polygon, and Base share AllUnity's deterministic UUPS proxy, implementation, minter, and admin; Arc has the same observed minter and default-admin roles but a different implementation whose upgrade authorization has not been verified. Tempo is an issuer-announced native TIP-20 deployment, and Solana is an issuer-listed Token-2022 mint with direct mint authority rather than an unaffiliated bridge representation.
